ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment restricted to current actuarial science majors April 2 - April 24. Class will be unrestricted during business hours the morning of April 25, 2019. Prospective transfers should review https://math.illinois.edu/system/files/inline-files/transfer-to-actsci-ui-only_0.pdf Prospective transfers who are not able to register on April 25 should fill out the form here by August 22 to be added to the request list: http://go.illinois.edu/MATH210FA19 After August 22, please send name, netid, 9-digit UIN, and reason for request to mathadvising@illinois.edu.
